# telnyx_external_connection_uploads (Data Source)

The requests to upload phone numbers to an external connection.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object whose items are listed.

### Optional

- `filter_civic_address_id` (String) The civic address ID to filter by
- `filter_location_id` (String) The location ID to filter by
- `filter_phone_number` (String) The phone number to filter by (exact match)
- `filter_phone_number_contains` (String) The phone number to filter by (partial match)
- `filter_status` (List of String) The status of the upload to filter by
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `external_connection_uploads` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_connection_uploads))

<a id="nestedatt--external_connection_uploads"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_connection_uploads`

Read-Only:

- `available_usages` (List of String)
- `error_code` (String) A code returned by Microsoft Teams if there is an error with the upload process.
- `error_message` (String) A message set if there is an error with the upload process.
- `location_id` (String)
- `status` (String) Represents the status of the upload on Microsoft Teams.
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `ticket_id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `tn_upload_entries` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_connection_uploads--tn_upload_entries))

<a id="nestedatt--external_connection_uploads--tn_upload_entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_connection_uploads.tn_upload_entries`

Read-Only:

- `civic_address_id` (String) Identifies the civic address assigned to the phone number entry.
- `error_code` (String) A code returned by Microsoft Teams if there is an error with the phone number entry upload.
- `error_message` (String) A message returned by Microsoft Teams if there is an error with the upload process.
- `internal_status` (String) Represents the status of the phone number entry upload on Telnyx.
- `location_id` (String) Identifies the location assigned to the phone number entry.
- `number_id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number in E164 format.
- `status` (String) Represents the status of the phone number entry upload on Microsoft Teams.
